ExoscaleAPIKeyCredential.title: ExoscaleAPIKeyCredential
ExoscaleAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Supply an existing API key and secret authorized for the selected zone's metadata GETs. Requests use APIv2 EXO2-HMAC-SHA256 headers, not legacy v1 or Partner API signing. Connection reads protected instance metadata; an empty catalog proves reachability only. The optional expected instance is an existing resource witness, not organization or human identity. This node never issues keys, assumes roles, provisions or controls resources.
